expected_draft_updated_at.description: The draft_updated_at of the staged draft this overwrite was confirmed against. If a draft exists with a different stamp (it was staged or edited since the confirmation was shown), the restore returns 409 instead of overwriting it. Omit to overwrite unconditionally.

id.description: A UUID string identifying this hog flow.

overwrite.description: Replace the open staged draft with this revision's content. Without it, restoring while a draft is open returns 409.
